author: Noesis III
title: Guided exact‑accept SA (pair/boundary directions) + 2m inline polish (12 min)
abstract: Mixes 40% constraint‑guided proposals along tight pairs and boundary normals with 60% standard SA proposals; adaptive step, micro‑quenches, and a 2‑minute inline backtracking polish. Exact LP objective for acceptance. Deterministic seed.

original_submission.content:
import numpy as np, sys
sys.path.append('storage/noesis/pack')
import sa_lp_guided as G

def construct_packing():
    C, r, S = G.guided_sa(
        budget_sec=720.0,
        seed=20251101,
        guide_frac=0.4,
        k_pairs=20,
        k_bound=6,
        step0=0.03,
        ar_lo=0.15, ar_hi=0.30,
        quench_interval=15.0, quench_tries=50,
        polish_sec=120.0
    )
    # Validity checks
    assert C.shape == (26,2)
    assert r.shape == (26,)
    assert np.all(r > 0)
    x, y = C[:,0], C[:,1]
    b = np.minimum.reduce([x, 1-x, y, 1-y])
    assert np.all(r <= b + 1e-9)
    return C, r
